commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' The resulting corner from Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is cleared.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 7:1.
85' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
83' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Luiz Junior.
80' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
78' Substitution. Viktor Tsygankov did his best and is replaced by Yaser Asprilla (Girona).
76' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
75' Great teamplay by Girona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
74' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Michel has decided to substitute Jhon Elmer Solis Romero and he is replaced by Ivan Martin (Girona).
70' It is time for a substitution. Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) is on for Yeremy Pino.

69' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
67' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
66' Here is a change. Pape Gueye is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
64' 5 - 0 Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it flies straight into the top right corner of the net!
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) will replace Nicolas Pepe.
59' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Ladislav Krejci (Girona) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
59' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 13:3.
56' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) for his blatant foul.
55' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
55' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
53' Vitor Reis (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
50' The corner from Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is cleared away by the defence.
49' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The game is over for Portu (Girona). Alex Moreno comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Michel decided to make a change. Dawda Camara (Girona) is replaced by Thomas Lemar.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Juan Foyth (Villarreal) comes off for Renato Veiga.
46' Marcelino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Thomas Partey comes on the pitch for Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
45+4' Etta Eyong (Villarreal) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Wasted effort! Joel Roca (Girona) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
44' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
42' Michel is forced to make a change. Yangel Herrera (Girona) is unable to continue due to injury, David Lopez comes on.
41' Yangel Herrera (Girona) picks up an injury.
39' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
36' Hugo Rincon (Girona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

33' Etta Eyong (Villarreal) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Vladyslav Krapyvtsov shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
31' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
28' 4 - 0 Goal! Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 4:0.

25' 3 - 0 Yeremy Pino sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Rafa Marin (Villarreal) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 3:0.
24' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
22' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
21' The resulting corner, taken by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona), comes to nothing.
20' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) takes the corner which is cleared.
16' 2 - 0 That's a goal we will see over and over again. Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) scores a beauty into the top left corner from a stunning cross. Put your own superlative here.
15' The game is interrupted. Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
13' Wasted effort! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
11' Daley Blind (Girona) brings his opponent down. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
7' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
5' A pass by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
2' Villarreal take a short corner kick.

2' Etta Eyong (Villarreal) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Vladyslav Krapyvtsov. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
Villarreal will kick the game off.
